about: Upgrade advisor (src/advisor.js; owner 2026-10-19: when a recipe gets more out of speeding up a lane, suggest buying it). Per box: the best quality-passing measured recipe per model, its predicted tok/s with each lane made probe_scale x faster or bigger, the binding lane (the probe with the largest gain), and every part row below re-predicted on that recipe. A part is suggested only when its low-end gain >= suggest_min_gain, one of its lanes is the binding lane, and the recipe passes quality. build.py copies this file to data.upgrade; report.js prints and returns the advice (data.json upgrade.advice, report --json upgrades).

settings.suggest_min_gain_src: lead brief 2026-10-19 (owner ask: suggest an upgrade when a recipe would get real use out of a faster lane): 20 % predicted decode gain at the low end of the part's bracket
settings.probe_scale_src: each lane probe makes one lane 2x faster (bandwidth, CPU kernel rate) or 2x bigger (capacity) and nothing else; the probe with the largest gain names the binding lane
settings.co_binding_min_extra_src: a lane pair (DRAM or PMem read ceiling + CPU kernel rate) binds as one lane when (1 + its 2x probe gain) beats the product of its members' (1 + gain) by 5 %: the two sit together, as on snoopy's DDR5 wall (60 % as a pair, 0.1 % apart); lanes on different tiers only compound (droopy V4.1: 1.2 %)
settings.exclude_tags_src: ledger rows the box map also leaves out (lab notes projected.exclude_tags)

lanes.vram_bw: GPU memory bandwidth (every GPU tier's read rate)
lanes.vram_cap: GPU memory for expert banks (the recipe's banks, or the first GPU's capacity)
lanes.dram_bw: DRAM read ceiling (the CPU kernel rate is fitted as a fraction of it and read as compute, so this lane moves only where reads hit the ceiling)
lanes.dram_cap: DRAM for experts (the recipe's RAM tier, node plan or the box usable figure)
lanes.cpu: CPU expert-kernel rate (cores, ISA, kernel code)

parts.part: 4x Intel Optane PMem 100 128 GB (NMA1XXD128GPS) into socket 0's second slots (2-2-2, 6-way App Direct)

bracket.src: lo = the box upgrade bw_scale (2.239: 30 GB/s both-socket, lab notes), hi = 3.0 (linear 6-way stripe); lab notes 2026-10-19 PMem 4-stick buy figure
